{-# LANGUAGE StrictData #-}
{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}

module QuickType
    ( TopLevel (..)
    , Color (..)
    , ValueUnion (..)
    , decodeTopLevel
    ) where

import Data.Aeson
import Data.Aeson.Types (emptyObject)
import Data.ByteString.Lazy (ByteString)
import Data.HashMap.Strict (HashMap)
import Data.Text (Text)

data TopLevel = TopLevel
    { colorTopLevel :: Color
    , theNameTopLevel :: Text
    , valueTopLevel :: ValueUnion
    } deriving (Show)

data Color
    = FireColor
    | GrassColor
    | OceanColor
    deriving (Show)

data ValueUnion
    = Amount Double
    | Presence Bool
    deriving (Show)

decodeTopLevel :: ByteString -> Maybe TopLevel
decodeTopLevel = decode

instance ToJSON TopLevel where
    toJSON (TopLevel colorTopLevel theNameTopLevel valueTopLevel) =
        object $ foldMap (maybe [] pure)
        [ Just $ "color" .= colorTopLevel
        , Just $ "name" .= theNameTopLevel
        , Just $ "value" .= valueTopLevel
        ]

instance FromJSON TopLevel where
    parseJSON (Object v) = TopLevel
        <$> v .: "color"
        <*> v .: "name"
        <*> v .: "value"

instance ToJSON Color where
    toJSON FireColor = "red"
    toJSON GrassColor = "green"
    toJSON OceanColor = "blue"

instance FromJSON Color where
    parseJSON = withText "Color" parseText
        where
            parseText "red" = return FireColor
            parseText "green" = return GrassColor
            parseText "blue" = return OceanColor

instance ToJSON ValueUnion where
    toJSON (Amount x) = toJSON x
    toJSON (Presence x) = toJSON x

instance FromJSON ValueUnion where
    parseJSON xs@(Number _) = (fmap Amount . parseJSON) xs
    parseJSON xs@(Bool _) = (fmap Presence . parseJSON) xs

package quicktype

import io.circe.syntax._
import io.circe._
import cats.syntax.functor._

// If a union has a null in, then we'll need this too... 
type NullValue = None.type

case class TopLevel (
    val color : Color,
    val name : String,
    val value : Value
) derives Encoder.AsObject, Decoder

enum Color : 
    case Fire
    case Grass
    case Ocean

given Decoder[Color] = Decoder.decodeString.emap {
    case "red" => scala.Right(Color.Fire)
    case "green" => scala.Right(Color.Grass)
    case "blue" => scala.Right(Color.Ocean)
    case other => scala.Left("invalid Color: " + other)
}
given Encoder[Color] = Encoder.encodeString.contramap {
    case Color.Fire => "red"
    case Color.Grass => "green"
    case Color.Ocean => "blue"
}

type Value = Double | Boolean
given Decoder[Value] = {
    List[Decoder[Value]](
        Decoder[Boolean].widen,
        Decoder[Double].widen,
    ).reduceLeft(_ or _)
}

given Encoder[Value] = Encoder.instance {
    case enc0 : Boolean => Encoder.encodeBoolean(enc0)
    case enc1 : Double => Encoder.encodeDouble(enc1)
}
